checks.detail: The app's first heading should be the note's title ("Evening"), read from amber.note.title: nothing around the app shows the title. Its first heading is "Tonight".

answer:
Your Evening note is now an evening check-in app. I looked at the Overview screen at phone and Mac widths. I didn't open the other screens, import or export, and nothing has been saved in the app yet.

The six weeks of demo data are created the first time you open the app. They run from 24 Aug to 5 Oct, so tonight shows as not logged. Plan has a "Load demo data" button and a "Clear all entries" button. Both ask you to tap twice, because pop-up confirmations don't show in this app.

- **Overview:** opens on tonight (logged or not), today's win, this week's hours against the budget, how each day felt, and habits done of planned. Today's win is the win you wrote in yesterday's check-in.
- **Tonight:** the check-in form.
  - Work hours, with +/− buttons.
  - Four 1–10 ratings: energy, mood, focus and sleep quality.
  - Only the habits planned for that weekday.
  - A "helped or hurt" line and tomorrow's one win.
  - A date field, so you can fill in or edit earlier days.
- **Week:** Monday to Sunday, with one review note per week that saves as you type. It also shows the numbers against last week and each day's detail.
- **Trends:** charts of the four ratings and of work hours, switchable between weekly and daily. The weekly hours chart has the budget line on it.
- **Plan:** the weekly hours budget (40 to start), habits per weekday with add, rename and delete, import, and export.
  - **Import:** paste rows from your spreadsheet, tab-separated or CSV. A header row is optional, rows with the same date are replaced, and habits it doesn't recognise are added to the plan.
  - **Export:** CSV and JSON, as downloads or copied to the clipboard. I haven't tested the downloads, so use Copy if one doesn't work.

The "Log tonight" button text and the "Overview" tab label are a bit low in contrast against their backgrounds. I left that as it comes from the app's default colours.
